verdict.rationale: SerpApi has no native natural-language command interface of its own. Its first-party MCP server (documented in integrations and the serpapi-mcp repo, with a hosted endpoint at mcp.serpapi.com) lets MCP-compatible agents such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor drive searches from a user's natural-language requests. That is NL operation mediated by an external agent client, and the evidence covers only the search tool rather than operating the product broadly. Missing for 10: a native NL interface in the product itself, documentation of which operations beyond search are exposed via MCP (e.g., account, archive, locations), and hands-on corroboration of NL-driven workflows.
